tokens.title: Color tokens
tokens.description: Every color comes from these tokens. Signal is only ever a fill with signal-ink text on top.

type.title: Typography
type.description: Geist for UI, Geist Mono with tabular figures for every compared number.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.description: One primary per view. Destructive actions always sit behind a confirm dialog. Icon buttons carry an aria-label.

forms.title: Inputs
forms.description: 40px fields (48px in onboarding). Labels above, helper or error below. Errors show a border and a message.
forms.brandNameHelper: Shown in reports and outreach drafts.
forms.websiteHelper: We remove https:// and trailing slashes as you type.
forms.voiceHelper: Orbit follows these notes in every draft.
forms.voiceSample: Warm and plain. Talk about farms and roast dates, not luxury.

display.title: Data display
display.description: Score rings use bands: 0–39 danger, 40–69 warning, 70–100 success. Deltas always show an arrow, a sign and a color.
display.scoreRings: Score rings (danger, warning, success, no data, small)
display.emptyDescription: Nothing here yet. Your first scan finishes in about {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
display.errorDescription: We couldn't reach {engine} this time. We'll retry at {time}; other engines are up to date.

charts.title: Charts
charts.description: Colors come from CSS variables, so charts restyle on theme change without re-mounting. Your brand is always first, blue and thickest.
charts.trendAria: Your visibility rose from 48 to 64; Bluebird Coffee stayed ahead at 72.

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: Messages, the approval gate and live task rows. Task progress is polled from the jobs API every 3 seconds.
agent.editClicked: The editor opens here in Phase 5.

table.title: Data table
table.description: Sticky header, end-aligned numbers, column picker and CSV export. Wide tables scroll inside their own container.
table.caption: Tracked keywords
table.emptyDescription: Add the keywords your customers search for and Orbit checks them daily.

overlays.title: Overlays
overlays.description: Menus and tabs move at 200 ms, sheets and the agent panel at 320 ms. Sheets open from the logical end side.
overlays.dialogDescription: A workspace holds its own team, billing and brands.
overlays.alertDescription: Sam loses access to Northwind Team right away. You can invite them again later.
overlays.sheetDescription: Docs, guides and a way to reach us.
